node.acceptance_condition: At least 3 distinct counterarguments with 2–4 sentences of support each, plus an explicit statement of the conditions under which AI art escapes kitsch; historically accurate in broad outline; no invented facts or citations.
node.expected_contribution: The defense case and the discriminating condition the essay's thesis will build its nuance around.
node.objective: Assemble the strongest honest counterargument: the case that AI art is not inherently kitsch. Deliver 3–4 distinct arguments (for example: kitsch is a property of use, intention, and reception rather than of tools; every new medium — photography, chromolithography, recorded music — was accused of kitsch and later produced genuine art; human selection, editing, and framing can impose risk and friction on AI output; formulaic sentiment long predates AI in human-made commercial art). Then state, in one or two sentences, what conditions distinguish a non-kitsch use of AI from a kitsch one.
node.rationale: Nuance under D3 means the essay must not simply convict AI art; this child supplies the defense that forces the thesis to be precise rather than sweeping.
